The syntax error in `obt_product_inventory` is fixed, and the model now builds.

The file is `models/analytics_obt/obt_product_inventory.sql`, not the path in the error message. In the `source` CTE, the `p.supplier_company` column was missing its trailing comma, so the parser read `p.standard_cost` as part of the previous expression. I added the comma and changed nothing else. `run_dbt` on `obt_product_inventory` succeeded.

I only checked that the model builds. I did not reconcile its numbers against the sources, since the task was about the syntax error.
